intro.title: FlyMe2TheMoon Web Demo
intro.desc: Play the complete 60-level game in your desktop browser. The first launch downloads approximately 145 MiB of assets; progress and settings are stored in this browser.

runtime.title: Live Demo
runtime.size: Full game · approximately 145 MiB of assets
runtime.cover: Ready for the moon? Start the full game below.
runtime.temporary: Browser storage is unavailable. Progress will be lost when this page closes.
runtime.failed: The game could not start. Reload the page to try again.
runtime.controls: Click the game to focus. Space / W / Up: thrust; A / D: steer. Hold the mouse below the character to fly. P: pause; R: retry; Esc: back. Supported gamepads can also be used.
runtime.note: Desktop browsers with WebGL 2 are required. Click the game or press a key to enable audio. Saves belong to this browser and website; clearing site data removes them.
